class.name: TwovoipOpusEncoder
class.brief_description: Prepares and encodes microphone chunks as Opus packets.
class.description: Resamples mono or stereo input, optionally applies RNNoise and gain, measures the result, and encodes it with Opus.

method.name: calc_audio_chunk_size
method.description: Returns the legacy input requirement for an output chunk.

method.name: create_opus_encoder
method.description: Creates the Opus encoder with the configured rate and channels.

method.name: create_sampler
method.description: Configures rates, channels, noise suppression, and output chunk size.

method.name: encode_chunk
method.description: Encodes the most recently processed chunk, prepending optional bytes.

method.name: get_gain
method.description: Returns the linear gain currently applied during processing.

method.name: get_automatic_gain
method.description: Returns whether automatic gain is active.

method.name: get_output_chunk_size
method.description: Returns the configured output frames per chunk.

method.name: get_peak
method.description: Returns the peak magnitude of the last processed chunk.

method.name: get_required_input_chunk_size
method.description: Returns the minimum safe input allocation for each processing call.

method.name: get_rms
method.description: Returns the RMS level of the last processed chunk.

method.name: get_speech_probability
method.description: Returns RNNoise speech probability for the last processed chunk.

method.name: process_chunk
method.description: Processes one chunk and returns the number of input frames consumed, or a negative error.

method.name: process_pre_encoded_chunk
method.deprecated: Use process_chunk() and the measurement getters.
method.description: Processes a chunk and returns the selected legacy measurement.

method.name: reset_opus_encoder
method.description: Resets Opus state before beginning an unrelated stream.

method.name: set_automatic_gain
method.description: Changes automatic gain mode and returns an Error code.

method.name: set_gain
method.description: Selects manual gain and sets its constant linear multiplier.

method.name: set_output_chunk_size
method.description: Sets the number of output frames produced by each processing call.
